title: Shimr ne johi khainchi baliya sakina ki
body:
SHIMR NE JO’HII KHAINCHI BAALIYAA SAKINA KII
<<DIVIDER>>
GOONJNE LAGII RAN ME SISKIYAA SAKINA KII
Jab qadam badhaate hai Koch sitamzadaa qaidi..(Koch sitam zadaa qaidi)
Tang hoti jaati hai reesmaa Sakina ki
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne jo’hii khainchi baaliyaa Sakina ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimr ne kahaa beti baap ko na roopaaye ..(baap ko na roo paaye)
Khainch ko rakho har dam rassiyaa Sakina ki
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne jo’hii khainchi baaliyaa Sakina ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek qadam badhaana bhi ab mohaal hai mera .. (ab mohaal hai mera)
Chilchuki hai aye ammaa aediyaa Sakina ki
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne jo’hii khainchi baaliyaa Sakina ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Bain the ye bacchi ke tishnagi ki shiddat se ..(tishnagi ki shiddat se)
Khushk hogayi saari haddiyaa Sakina ki
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne jo’hii khainchi baaliyaa Sakina ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Bole Abid e muztar waqte dafn zindaa me ..(waqte dafn zindaa me)
Choor hogayi saari phasliyaa Sakina ki
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne jo’hiikhainchibaaliyaa Sakina ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Dafn bhai kartahai ab behan ko zindaa me .. ab behan ko zindaa me
Dekhtihai ye manzarhaaye maa Sakina ki
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne jo’hiikhainchibaaliyaa Sakina ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Marqade Sakina par hashr dekiye Aijaz ..(hashr dekhiye Aijaz)
Goonjti hai zindaa me hichkiyaa Sakina ki
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne jo’hiikhainchibaaliyaa Sakina ki
